abi.DS4: four half2(d,sum), one per 32 values; Q4_K/Q5_K
abi.D4: four float32 d, one per 32 values; Q6_K
abi.quant: d=amax/127; q=round(x/d); DS4 sum is raw pre-quant fp32 subgroup sum
abi.layout: records are transposed by activation column; each record is one column's 128-K slice

constraints: DS4 and D4 records have equal size but incompatible metadata interpretation
Q4 gate and up may share one DS4 packet
Q/K/V may share one DS4 packet only when all three weights use DS4
mixed Q4/Q4/Q6 QKV needs one DS4 plus one D4 producer unless Q6 consumer ABI is generalized
